rows.TEXT:
Fyrwenn 
"Human, we have decided to follow you to your camp. But be warned...no trickery or -"

Tora'ach 
"Or we'll put an arrow through the back of your neck before you can even cry out for help!"

Wells 
"A wise choice, people of the forest. I'm sure this is all simply a misunderstanding. And you've nothing to worry about from me, though the demons will no doubt make this an interesting journey."

Wells 
"If we plan on traveling near the city Orbuk, I would advise you send me first. I'd like to...return...these arrows to their owner."

Tora'ach 
"What's the problem? Put an arrow in him!"

Wells 
"Please, lower your bows! I intend no battle here today. As you can see, I've already had my share."

Tora'ach 
"Why do you venture into our woods? Surely you know the dangers of approaching Elven lands now?"

Wells 
"I was sent by my King to invite your ambassadors to a council. It seems as though recent events are confusing his advisors. I'm a man of the forest myself, I do not dabble in politics, but I do have orders to escort you to my camp."

Tora'ach 
"Fair enough. But why should we bother? And why do you have arrows stuck in your back?"

Wells 
"Perhaps the Empire and the Elves can again have peace, but it is not my concern. The demons are hiding within the woods. I can guide you past them - as you can see, their quivers are at least a little less full now."

Wells 
"I will set up my own camp and tend to my wounds, though my backpack seems to have taken more abuse than my body. We must move soon, so I can only give you two nights to make your decision."

Tora'ach 
"I, for one, am much more comfortable without the Human's presence. What do you think, Fyrwenn?"

Scout 
"The Ranger is still out there. He's very patient."

Fyrwenn 
"He seems to be an honest man. I believe we should send representatives with him. Perhaps Gallean wishes us to avoid war after all."

Oracle 
"I have been listening...but I receive no instructions. I hear weeping, and then laughing. Is it possible...I mean...could a god go mad?"

Tora'ach 
"Mad? We return to our roots! We are wild - forces of nature, to be feared by the civilized world. If anything, Gallean has become sane! We should slay the Human. Why seek peace when we know who caused this conflict in the first place?"

Illumielle 
"Perhaps we are simply unable to comprehend Gallean's intentions. I agree with Tora'ach. We should not question them. However, I do not believe we should kill this Human. Perhaps he is part of a divine plan?"

Tora'ach 
"I await a decision. If you wish him slain, we must do it today. If we are to spare him, we should prepare for travel tomorrow."

Wells 
"I know you're still here. Show yourselves!"

Scout 
"Bethrezen's minions...certainly the Human ranger would have been able to warn us of their presence if we had allowed him to lead the way..."
"You must support the decisions of your leaders. We act on behalf of Gallean. He would not allow us to make mistakes."

Wells 
"Wait! See the scorch marks on my sleeve? The demons nearly killed me with a fire trap in these woods."

Wells 
"There. I am...fairly confident...it will not trigger as we pass through now."

Scout 
"Agh! The demons left traps in these woods!"

Wells 
"Ah, I hid something near here while the demons were at my heels. One moment."

Wells 
"This ought to help us buy supplies."

Tora'ach 
"Bethrezen's Stalkers still roam the woods, searching for that Human ranger. It's no mystery that we've not heard from the Empire...the Demons must pick off their messengers before they ever reach us."

Illumielle 
"We have no choice; we must deal with whatever the dark god puts in front of us."

Tora'ach 
"Aye, but these bastards are completely mad...they're likely to attack their own kind as much as their enemies."

Wells 
"You near the camp. My people will no doubt be edgy, so I would advise approaching slowl..."

Bandit 
"He's delivering us to our deaths! We won't go so easily!"

Fyrwenn 
"You fool! You have just started a war! Is that what you wanted? Arrest that man!"
"Humans, we approach! We do not intend to attack!"

Feinns 
"Where is Wells? Please, send him forward and we can begin this unpleasant negotiation..."
"Wells is no longer with us. Those responsible have been dealt with, I assure you."

Willdren 
"They've killed him! I knew it! These loathsome people have been murdering every messenger we send to them!"

Memrick 
"We must alert King Emry at once!"
Kill the Empire messengers before they can deliver their message.

Memrick 
"This will buy you little time...Emry will see you buried."

Memrick 
"Hah! Enjoy your defeat, Elves! It won't be long before the full weight of the Empire tears down your wretched forests!"

Feinns 
"Farewell, Elves. We will meet again, but I will have many, many more troops with me. Hahahah!"

Willdren 
"Murderers! You'd best flee, for when I return, I will bring the wrath of the entire Empire with me!"

Tora'ach 
"It is done. But what next?"

Oracle 
"We continue to the Human camp as planned. Gallean has not directed us otherwise."

Fyrwenn 
"The whirlwind has already begun. We must finish this. The Empire will surely invade our territories now if we simply retreat. Perhaps there is still hope for reasonable talks."

Tora'ach 
"The Human ranger has been killed. Unfortunate, despite his race, he seemed brave enough."
"Let them run. These filthy creatures are only effective in numbers anyway."

Lizard Man 
"Disssgusssting ssslaves of Gallean. May you catch ssswamp plague."
"We don't intend to stay here long."

Barbarian Chieftain 
"Elves? Why do you seek new enemies?"

Illumielle 
"Oracle, it has occurred to me that I have never asked for your name. We say 'oracle' with such reverence, we've never considered that you must be more lost in all of this than anyone. Please, share it with me."

Oracle 
"It is Millu, M'Lady, but I no longer feel as though I am the same Millu I was a year ago. I am but an arrow used to deliver a message of far greater importance."

Illumielle 
"Don't underestimate your value to us...Millu. We may have doubted you before, but there isn't an Elf now that will refuse to stand behind you. You are our blessing, regardless of our confusion."

Millu 
"Thank you, M'Lady. I only pray my mind is clear enough to understand the will of Gallean."

Sentry 
"You saw it too, then. I thought I'd drifted into sleep for a moment. I didn't get a good enough look at it to say...but we'd better alert Illumielle nonetheless."

Wells 
"If you'll trust me to guide you, I can make this journey easier. If you escort me north, just past Vembria, there is a rather nasty surprise I can spoil."

Wells 
"When I neared the Demon city, I was forced to bury a certain valuable I possessed. Help me return, and I will sell it to buy us supplies."

Tora'ach 
"Fyrwenn. Why do we waste the lives of our people when we can simply call on our old allies? It would take but a small command an-"

Fyrwenn 
"Out of the question! Dragons are not servants to our people! We've no right to call them to battle."

Tora'ach 
"If the nobles will not assist us, we may have to do it ourselves!"

Fyrwenn 
"And you will die. Only those of the purest bloodline can even communicate with them! You think your little band of thugs can tame a dragon?"
Welcome, traveler. Surely something upon these walls catches your eye?
Greetings, brothers. How may I aid you in your journeys?
I can teach you mind magic. My sister in Petumbria may teach you magic of the air.
I can harness the powers of the very air around you. I can teach you to do the same.
We don't need to know the details, we just need to see your cash.

Every child trembles at the hearing of this most infamous name. This lord of hell is known for his blood thirsts. It is said that he once ate 1000 slaves at a banquet given by Bethrezen for a victory against the kingdom of light.
